sub_graphs.title: EIP-6780: SELFDESTRUCT State Transition
sub_graphs.description: Models the state transitions when SELFDESTRUCT opcode is executed, distinguishing between same-transaction creation and other scenarios

nodes.label: Contract Executing
nodes.description: Contract code is executing in the EVM and encounters SELFDESTRUCT opcode

nodes.label: Check if Created in Same TX
nodes.description: Determine if the contract was created in the same transaction as the SELFDESTRUCT call

nodes.label: Same-TX Creation Detected
nodes.description: System has determined the contract was created in this transaction

nodes.label: Not Same-TX Creation
nodes.description: System has determined the contract existed before this transaction

nodes.label: Delete Contract State
nodes.description: Delete storage, code, and account data (original SELFDESTRUCT behavior)

nodes.label: Transfer Balance Only
nodes.description: Transfer full balance to target address without deleting account state

nodes.label: Contract Destroyed
nodes.description: Contract state is deleted, balance transferred, account zeroed

nodes.label: Contract Persists
nodes.description: Contract code and storage persist, only balance transferred

nodes.label: Execution Halted
nodes.description: Contract execution has halted after SELFDESTRUCT processing

external_entities.name: Transaction Sender
external_entities.description: External account that initiated the transaction triggering SELFDESTRUCT

sub_graphs.title: EIP-6780: Gas Refund Changes
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas refund behavior changes when SELFDESTRUCT is called in non-creation transactions

nodes.label: Check Refund Eligibility
nodes.description: Determine if gas refund should be issued based on creation context

nodes.label: Refund Ineligible
nodes.description: No refund issued for non-same-transaction SELFDESTRUCT

nodes.label: EIP-2929 Rules Apply
nodes.description: EIP-2929 access list gas rules are applied

sub_graphs.title: EIP-6780: Ether Burning Security Boundary
sub_graphs.description: Models the Ether burning behavior when SELFDESTRUCT targets the executing contract

nodes.label: SELFDESTRUCT Targets Self
nodes.description: SELFDESTRUCT called with target equal to executing contract address

nodes.label: Check Burn Conditions
nodes.description: Determine if Ether burning can occur based on creation context

nodes.label: Ether Burn Enabled
nodes.description: Contract created in same TX, Ether will be burned

nodes.label: Ether Burn Disabled
nodes.description: Pre-existing contract, balance transferred but account persists

nodes.label: Burn Ether
nodes.description: Ether is permanently destroyed (transferred to self during deletion)

nodes.label: Ether Burned
nodes.description: Ether has been permanently removed from circulation

ambiguities.text: The specification states 'the same transaction as contract creation' but does not clarify if this includes contracts created via internal calls (CREATE/CREATE2) or only direct deployment transactions.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'same transaction' includes all contract creation contexts within the transaction, including internal CREATE/CREATE2 calls. This needs verification against implementation.

ambiguities.text: The EIP does not specify behavior for contracts created via CREATE2 that are destroyed and then re-created at the same address within the same transaction.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume each creation event resets the same-transaction flag, allowing subsequent SELFDESTRUCT to function normally within that transaction.

implicit_assumptions.description: The EVM correctly tracks contract creation events within a transaction to determine SELFDESTRUCT eligibility.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect tracking could allow unauthorized state deletion of pre-existing contracts or prevent legitimate destruction of same-TX created contracts.

implicit_assumptions.description: Developers using CREATE2 redeploy patterns have migrated to ERC-2535 proxy patterns or alternative upgrade mechanisms.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Existing contracts relying on SELFDESTRUCT for upgrades will become non-upgradeable, potentially leading to locked funds or stuck functionality.

implicit_assumptions.description: Applications burning Ether via self-targeting SELFDESTRUCT have been updated to deploy and destroy in the same transaction.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Ether burning mechanisms fail silently, leading to unexpected token economics.
